name: smooth-agent
description: Big Smooth orchestration for Claude Code: tmux-supervised worker sessions that run in parallel, coordinate over th-mail, and track work in pearls. Auto-onboards every Claude Code session to the th-mail bus at startup, then nudges it to self-rename to a task-meaningful handle. Provides the /smooth command and a windows-build-box skill (throwaway Windows EC2 over SSM). Also ships the shared SmooAI repo guardrails as hooks (worktree enforcement, th-over-curl nudges, pearls-label reminder, pearl-store read-only-wedge guard) so the SmooAI repos stop hand-copying .claude/hooks.
